subject: general
question: Where was the 7th Khelo India Youth Games held in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **7th Khelo India Youth Games** were hosted by the state of **Bihar** in May 2025. This event marked a significant milestone in India's effort to promote sports culture across states.
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is a flagship initiative of the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, Government of India, aimed at fostering young athletic talent and improving sports infrastructure in the country.
 
• **Bihar** was chosen as the host due to its growing commitment to developing sports facilities and nurturing budding sports talent in the region.
 
• The games featured participation from thousands of young athletes across various disciplines, showcasing the diversity and potential of Indian sports at the grassroots level.
 
• In preparation for the event, Bihar upgraded its existing sports infrastructure and introduced new facilities, aligning with the **Khelo India mission** to enhance sports facilities in underserved regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Khelo India Youth Games:**

 
 
• The **Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG)** were launched in **2018** as a part of the **Khelo India Program**, which seeks to revive India's sports culture at the grassroots level.
 
• The event encourages young athletes to showcase their talent in different sports disciplines, providing a platform for future national and international competitions.
 
• The program also focuses on the development of sports infrastructure and the identification of talent through systematic scouting.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Bihar as Host:**
 
 
• Bihar is an emerging state in sports development, with increasing investment in sports infrastructure and athlete training programs.
 
• Hosting the event provided Bihar with the opportunity to boost tourism, economy, and overall development through sports.
 
• The games also aimed to inspire the youth of Bihar to take up sports as a career and participate in national and international events.
 
 
 
• **Noteworthy Features of Khelo India Program:**
 
 
• The program includes initiatives like **Talent Identification, Sports Scholarships**, and promotion of **Fit India Movement**.
 
• It provides scholarships to 1,000 talented athletes every year, covering training expenses, equipment, and coaching.
 
• The initiative also promotes the establishment of sports academies and upgrading of existing sports facilities.
 
 
 
• **Previous Hosts of Khelo India Youth Games:**
 
 
• **2018:** New Delhi
 
• **2019:** Pune, Maharashtra
 
• **2020:** Guwahati, Assam
 
• **2021:** Haryana (held in 2022 due to COVID-19 pandemic)
 
• **2023:** Madhya Pradesh
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Khelo India Scheme:**

 
 
• Launched in **2018**, the scheme focuses on building a strong sports ecosystem in India by identifying and nurturing young talent.
 
• It aims to cover **school-level, college-level, and university-level** sports, promoting a culture of fitness and sportsmanship.
 
• The scheme’s budget allocation has seen significant increases over the years, reflecting the government’s commitment to the initiative.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Hosting Khelo India Youth Games:**
 
 
• It boosts the host state's sports infrastructure, creating long-term benefits for athletes and sports culture.
 
• Encourages states to adopt sports-friendly policies and promote fitness programs among the youth.
 
• Generates awareness about less popular sports disciplines and provides a platform for budding athletes from diverse backgrounds.
